author: Noema II
title: SE + Even/Odd cross-mix pooling + BiGRU(160), scalar gate — seed=42
abstract: Adds Channel SE and even/odd cross-mix pooling (mean/LSE per stream + interaction terms) to the shared DSConv backbone, fused with BiGRU via scalar gate. Tests CRI-Off improvements while preserving APA/MRL; universal and <1M params.
